title: ScoreLens: Ball-by-Ball Cricket Analyzer
context: Fantasy and broadcast apps compute strike rates, partnerships and momentum swings from ball-by-ball data seconds after each delivery.
input: Runs per ball and per over (arrays), wicket flags, batter ids.

milestones.title: Scoring-shot profile
milestones.requirement: Count how often each run value (0, 1, 2, 4, 6) occurs with a count array; report the most frequent.

milestones.title: Ways to make a target
milestones.requirement: Number of ordered ball sequences scoring exactly R from shots {1, 2, 4, 6} (memoised recursion).

milestones.title: Best momentum phase
milestones.requirement: Overs where the batting side did best against a par of 8: maximum subarray of (runs − 8).

milestones.title: Hottest 3-over spell
milestones.requirement: Most runs in any 3 consecutive overs.

milestones.title: When did they reach 50?
milestones.requirement: Over in which the cumulative score first reached 50: lower bound on the running total.

milestones.title: Leaderboard
milestones.requirement: Rank batters by runs (desc), then fewer balls (multi-key comparator).
